checkpoints.description: [1/1] Reject rendered markup and fingerprint the verification ruleset

impact_assessment.why: Free-form certificate fields reached Markdown/HTML renderers without a parsed-value ban, and results did not record which rules produced them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Unsafe metadata fails at admission and results from different rule profiles cannot be compared as if identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stricter cert_from_dict validation and a new result field; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only verification; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate rendered fields in cert_from_dict, keep renderer escaping, add a declarative fingerprint/compare API, and pin both with unit tests.

[1/5] Plan register v2: freshness window, typed revocation reasons and as-of verification; writer/CLI parity in ops

impact_assessment.why: The public register has no freshness metadata and free-text revocations; a stale cache cannot be detected and an as-of question cannot distinguish a key-compromise revocation from a prospective termination
impact_assessment.benefits: Verifiers fail closed on a stale register, revocations carry a closed reason code and optional invalidity date, and an explicit historical check returns VALID_AS_OF without authorizing current use
impact_assessment.risks: contract: register version 2 and new entry fields break old readers; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: ops writer updates metadata on every save; state: empty register migrated, old v1 copies become undated
impact_assessment.mitigation: v2 writer and verifier released together; v1 is read but reported UNDATED; current verification stays fail-closed on any revoked entry; as-of is a separate flag; failing-first tests for stale, typed, retroactive and old-reader cases
